summary: Comprehensive testing of 3 bug fixes in Tactical Board at /tactical-board.html. All 3 bugs have been VERIFIED FIXED: 1) 3D view now shows sport-specific fields (volleyball=wood court, basketball=wood court, boxing=dark mat, tennis=green court, football=green field), 2) Elements are preserved when switching between 2D/2.5D/3D views (tested with 8 elements - count stayed at 8 across all view switches), 3) Volleyball 3D now shows a volleyball net with posts and mesh (not a football field).
critical_code_review_comments: Bug Fix 1 VERIFIED: setView() no longer calls setSport() - now uses renderFieldOnly() for 2D/2.5D and render3DField() for 3D, preserving elements
Bug Fix 2 VERIFIED: render3DField() checks ST.sport and renders sport-specific 3D fields with proper surface colors via get3DSportColors()
Bug Fix 3 VERIFIED: render3DFieldObjects() adds volleyball net (posts + mesh), tennis net, basketball hoops, boxing ropes, and football goals
Code structure is clean - all 3D rendering functions are well-organized: get3DSportColors(), render3DFieldLines(), render3DFieldObjects()
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 reported bugs have been fixed and verified: 1) Sport-specific 3D fields work correctly - volleyball shows wood court, basketball shows wood court with hoops, boxing shows dark mat with ropes, tennis shows green court with net, football shows green field with goals. 2) Elements (players, cones, balls, arrows) are preserved when switching between 2D, 2.5D, and 3D views - tested with 8 elements and count remained 8 across all view switches. 3) Volleyball 3D shows a proper volleyball net with posts and mesh, NOT a football field. The joystick appears only in 3D mode as expected. Save modal, gallery tab, undo/redo, grid toggle, and zoom controls all work correctly.
